diagnosis.rationale: The undiluted readings flatten near 0.65–0.71 from 7 h onward, but 10-fold dilution of retained late aliquots reveals much higher biomass. At 18 h, triplicate 1:10 readings were 0.3369, 0.3239, and 0.3295 (mean 0.3301), corresponding to an undiluted-equivalent OD600 of 3.301 rather than the direct reading of 0.673. Nearby late-time 1:10 readings likewise imply 3.231 at 15 h, 3.501 at 16 h, and 3.281 at 17 h, versus undiluted readings of only 0.6754, 0.709, and 0.6353. Thus, across the final hours, the undiluted assay underestimates culture biomass by roughly fivefold, consistent with a nonlinear/saturated reader response.
